create_pixel_decoder: create a PixelDecoder module that predicts masks from image embeddings using a CNN with configurable upscaling stages
build_pixel_decoder_upscaling: build a PixelDecoder with custom upscale_stages and bilinear upscaling to transform image embeddings into predicted masks
test_pixel_decoder_forward: test the PixelDecoder forward pass by passing image embeddings and verifying predicted mask output shape
refactor_pixel_decoder_pixelwise: refactor the PixelDecoder to use pixelwise mode with Conv2d output layer for per-pixel bit prediction
review_pixel_decoder_sigmoid: review the PixelDecoder with sigmoid_output enabled to ensure predicted bits are bounded between 0 and 1
